Introduction

Official API documentation for the multi-tenant CBT platform.

Base URL: http://localhost

Welcome to the " . config('app.name') . " API documentation.

This API allows you to manage tenants, students, and CBT examinations.

Base URL: {" . config('app.url') . "}/api

Authentication

All requests must be authenticated using a Bearer token.

Authenticating requests

To authenticate requests, include an Authorization header with the value "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}".

All authenticated endpoints are marked with a requires authentication badge in the documentation below.

You can retrieve your token by visiting your dashboard and clicking Generate API token.

Endpoints

POST api/auth/login

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://localhost/api/auth/login" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"identifier\": \"architecto\",
    \"password\": \"|]|{+-\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost/api/auth/login"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "identifier": "architecto",
    "password": "|]|{+-"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
Received response:
Request failed with error:

If you're a maintainer of ths API, verify that your API is running and you've enabled CORS.
You can check the Dev Tools console for debugging information.

schoolName   string

  • Secondary School
  • Mixed

Must not be greater than 255 characters. Example: n

email   string     

Must be a valid email address. Must not be greater than 255 characters. Example: ashly64@example.com

phone   string     

Must not be greater than 20 characters. Example: vdljnikhwaykcmyu

password   string     

Must be at least 8 characters. Example: Xaz<m5L[)~=NG5a

plan_id   string  optional    

Example: architecto

class_level_id   string     

Must be a valid UUID. The id of an existing record in the class_levels table. Example: 6b72fe4a-5b40-307c-bc24-f79acf9a1bb9

topic_id   string  optional    

Must be a valid UUID. The id of an existing record in the topics table. Example: 977e5426-8d13-3824-86aa-b092f8ae52c5

type   string     

Example: fill_blank

Must be one of:
  • mcq_single
  • mcq_multi
  • true_false
  • fill_blank
  • short_answer
  • essay
  • matching
  • ordering
difficulty   string     

Example: hard

  • easy
  • medium
  • hard
content   string     

Example: architecto

explanation   string  optional    

Example: architecto

default_marks   number     

Must be at least 0.5. Must not be greater than 100. Example: 22

time_estimate_seconds   integer  optional    

Must be at least 10. Example: 22

metadata   object  optional    
tags   object  optional    
source   string  optional    

Example: architecto

year   integer  optional    

Example: 16

options   object[]  optional

label   string  optional    

Must not be greater than 10 characters. Example: ngzmiy

content   string  optional    

This field is required when options is present. Example: architecto

image_url   string  optional    

Must be a valid URL. Must not be greater than 500 characters. Example: http://bailey.com/

is_correct   boolean  optional    

This field is required when options is present. Example: false

order   integer  optional    

Example: 16

match_pair   string  optional    

Must not be greater than 255 characters. Example: n

fill_blank_answers   object[]  optional    

Fill-blank answers: required for fill_blank type. This field is required when type is fill_blank. Must have at least 1 items.
answer_text   string  optional    

This field is required when fill_blank_answers is present. Must not be greater than 255 characters. Example: g

is_primary   boolean  optional    

Example: false
